    Where can I watch UCLA basketball?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    To watch UCLA basketball in the 2025-2026 season, you will need a combination of Big Ten network partners, specifically
    FOX/FS1, CBS, BTN (Big Ten Network), and Peacock. Live TV streaming services like YouTube TV, Fubo, or Hulu + Live TV provide coverage for most games, while Peacock is necessary for exclusive Big Ten games. 
    Top Ways to Watch UCLA Bruins Basketball 
    • Live TV Streaming Services: Fubo, YouTube TV, and Hulu + Live TV offer CBS, FOX, FS1, and BTN in their base packages. Fubo also offers a free trial.
    • Peacock: Peacock is mandatory for exclusive Big Ten conference games, featuring roughly seven or more UCLA games.
    • Broadcast TV:
      Games on CBS can be streamed via Paramount+.
    • NCAA Tournament: Games in the 2026 NCAA tournament will air on CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV. 
    Other Options 
    • B1G+: For early-season or non-conference games, a subscription to B1G+ may be needed.
    • Audio Coverage: The UCLA Bruins Audio Network provides free audio streams for games. 
    For the most up-to-date schedule and channel info, check UCLA Bruins' official website before each game.
